goal: Focused test files of this repository pass under concurrent load: every bun test invocation runs under a default per-test timeout of 30000 ms while an explicit per-test timeout still overrides it, and the pi-batch-authority and claude-batch-authority fixtures copy one template Git repository initialized once per test process instead of running git init per fixture (Spec branch-boundary D1, D2).

acceptance.assertion: A bun test run from the repository root of a fixture test with no explicit timeout that takes about 6000 ms passes; a fixture test with an explicit 200 ms timeout that takes 400 ms still fails; tests/test-runtime-config.test.ts drives both through a child bun test process and checks each exit status.

tests/git-template.test.ts shows that two copies of the template repository start at the same HEAD with the same tracked files and local identity, that a commit in one copy leaves the other copy's HEAD and worktree unchanged, that a copy contains no worktree metadata, and that the template is initialized once per process.
pi-batch-authority and claude-batch-authority create every fixture through the shared template helper and all their existing tests still pass with unchanged assertions.
